絶対にインストールするな！

title: Little Shops
content: The five-stars is for real! What I found is that Temu consists of many little shops that you’re purchasing from. So, yes, the items are made and shipped from China, BUT, I like the fact that I’m supporting many “little shops” instead of just big stores like the U.S. has. What I have learned is that there are many of these little shops that sell “fakes”, or replicas of the same well-made item at another little store on Temu. (So Temu is similar to EBay, but without bidding, and much more affordable!) You may want to make a list of the stores you get good items from, so when you reorder, you don’t get a non-legit item (or fake). I have fun just adding cool things to my Wishlist: on item, scroll down, passed the reviews, and you’ll see the little empty heart and “wishlist “ by that. Tap heart to save in your wishlist.

Dieses Verhalten ist für mich absolut inakzeptabel. Ich fühle mich als Kunde nicht ernst genommen und habe das Vertrauen in Ihr Unternehmen vollständig verloren. Ich möchte mit einem Unternehmen, das meine berechtigte Reklamation nicht ordnungsgemäß bearbeitet und mir widersprüchliche bzw. falsche Informationen gibt, nichts mehr zu tun haben.

title: Pay Close Attention To The Listed Product Dimensions
content: If you pay close attention to the listed product dimensions, you won’t be terribly disappointed. I have purchased a WIDE variety of products from Temu and learned quickly that I MUST read the measurements of the item before selecting it. Once I started doing that, along with reading reviews, I haven’t been disappointed as often as I had been. Actually, some of those early purchases gave me great & hilarious stories to share! I play the daily return to gain your prize promotion & have received a lot of great stuff for free. I still don’t understand the “pre-claim” free items yet. I figure, if it doesn’t show in my cart as an addition that’s free, I just click out because I have been burnt by purchasing items in the required amount necessary but unsure if I was receiving the free items or not. The site is great but can be EXTREMELY confusing as to what you get for what you spin. It’s like there’s two totally different “carts” depending on promotion. It’s annoying. The rules don’t list out the exact pre-claim definition so I have been too chicken to purchase the cart filled that completes the requirement. Again, if it’s not listed as free in my cart, it doesn’t exist so I don’t complete that purchase & just leave them there for future reference. I do love the site but every purchase does feel a bit like a gamble, hoping I receive something of relatively good quality. Lately, I have received higher quality items & have been pleased. Just read every detail & you’ll like it too!

title: Great deals and features, but watch out for misleading listings and annoying pop-ups.
content:
The Temu app is full of great values and unique features, but it definitely requires you to be a careful shopper. You have to pay close attention to the product descriptions because items are often presented visually larger than they actually are. Additionally, the list pricing can be very misleading; listings frequently display the price for the lowest quantity while showing a photo and description of the highest quantity—like showing a 100-count pack of pens with a $20 price, but when you open the item, the $20 price is for a 20-count option. Opening the app can also be a chore, as you’re instantly bombarded with intrusive, time-consuming animations for coupons and discounts that require a purchase to use, taking multiple clicks just to dismiss.
That being said, the perks keep me coming back. I really appreciate the $5 on-time delivery guarantee and the excellent price adjustment feature, which lets you request a partial refund if an item’s price drops after you buy it. Being able to buy customized items without minimum orders or setup fees is also a huge plus. The app is honestly kind of addicting, and I will definitely continue to use it despite the annoying quirks.

title: Read carefully the descriptions
content:
Not happy with Temu.  A lot of cheap and poor quality goods that look good in photos but are generally a lot smaller than pictured.  A lot of unfair marketing practices encouraging people to buy more.  4 items for free, but after selecting my choices I then he ad to purchase a lot of goods to obtain the free items.  When buying the required items and paying for them I then discovered that I would only receive one free item and would have to make further purchases on another day to get the next item free. A big con as I tested this buy adding further items to a certain amount to my basket only to be offer a small discount of less than £2 with no mention of the next free item.    In all fairness, some of the items I have purchased have been good quality at a fair price but also a lot of rubbish goods.  Yesterday I received a batch of 50 paint brushes plainly showing 1” on the metal binding but only measure just under 20mm and the laughable part is that there was more loose bristles in the delivery bag than there was in the brushes.  They went straight into my rubbish bin.
Best tip I can offer is double read and study the description before buying especially delivery times as some items will be shipped overland from the other side of the planet.
Happy shopping and be careful.

title: At times infuriating
content:
I came to Temu after no one would ship to me on AliExpress. I never had this issue until right around the time Trump put tariffs on China. After that 99% of items cannot be shipped to me. And so far I have not been able to get any sort of explanation as to why.

So that’s the backstory of how I got here. The app is ok. Funding terms is easy and there’s always something interesting but you need to read very carefully everything and if the description doesn’t tell you everything about the item then walk away.  If you want quality then you will pay up for it.  If something seems too good to be true it usually is. Sometimes you get lucky on the cheap items and get something useful but that’s like 1 out of ten. The retail prices they list are a joke. Like $159 for a mop but their prices is $13. So you are getting an amazing deal right? Definitely look at the dimensions of an item. They are photographed and sometimes shopped to look much larger then actually are. Also read read read the reviews of products and learn to filter out the bot reviews that are always giving 5 stars.

The worst thing about this app is all the sneaky deals they shove in your face and you need to listen to their BS before you can escape. Most of the time. You will be required to spend upwards of $400 to get a big reward. If you may not have to spend more than $44 to get a few free pics. It’s from a limited pool of Items.

Naja … wie gesagt: kleines Manko!

I have had both returns and refunds with no problems if they were from Temu but if you order from a “Lical” shipper in the USA you are pretty much on your own. They have updated so now you can contact the 3rd party so it may be easier now. I ordered litter a few years ago and only received 1 of the 3 containers ( you could only order sets of 3). I should have read the reviews and I would have known better. Be a shrewd shopper. 1) check the listed size and do not order if there is any doubt 2) be sure to check the reviews, especially the low stars ones and see if people are using products or rating when the package comes 3) do check you products, most stores will gladly send missing parts or exchange items. 4) The MAGNETS ( real/ natural ones) are great and I even got the tiny ones for magnet boards and had to pull hard to get them apart. The others I bought stick to ceiling nails soundly and metal frames of doors. I bought some tiny ones for craft/ fridge decorations are they occasionally will slide if overloaded but can hold 3 sheets grandkid art without a problem ( you may initially have trouble pulling them apart if they are less than 0.5mm because of their strength. Happy Shopping!

title: Does temu think I’m stupid?
content: I used a “get up to 90% off” and got 86% off, and found an endoscope, and found out I’m paying a slight mark up. Good thing I didn’t order it before looking at the same one in my cart. The same one in my cart was less than 13 dollars, and with the 86% off, I found that the item cost a little more. Temu tries to make you feel like you’re getting a better deal, but you’re actually paying a markup. Update: I tried the 99.9 percent off offer, and paid what it said to pay. It says only 7 dollars left, I added a 9 dollar item, and then it said 6.55 left?! It’s clearly trying to nickel and dime me. I’m canceling those orders and then deleting this disrespectful and deceptive app from my device. I thought I could get good deals, but as it turns out, they try to scam you blind. I might be stupid, but not that stupid. And I better be able to cancel these orders, That have been placed with just one click, and no confirmation option, and then got me by surprise. It should ask if I’m sure I want to check out for prize and show how much is left, not just place the order without my consent. I guess Chinese companies like to trick you into buying something you didn’t consent to. I just tried Ali express, and it gave me 2 welcome gifts, nothing expensive, but the app seems true to itself. What I like to see, is transparency, not opaqueness. And temu is a perfect example of opaqueness. Hopefully Ali express won’t stiff me like this one did.

content: At one time I was skeptical of purchasing through TEMU, just because I didn’t know anything about them. So after installing the app, and browsing through it, I decided to give them a try with a smaller order. I’m really pleased with them, and the products offered. And loads of their products come from LOCAL warehouse’s, so there’s no tariffs on them, and they get a fast delivery. And the prices are really excellent. A lot of products you get off of other sites, are the same manufacturer, but at a higher price. From now on, I’ll be comparing prices before purchasing just about anything. I’m very pleased with TEMU.

Die Lieferung kam schließlich pünktlich und mängelfrei (!) zum vorausgesagten Zeitpunkt.
Die Qualität der Ware hat mich vor allem in Hinblick auf die unschlagbar günstigen Preise absolut überzeugt. Sie entsprechen auch weitgehend den Beschreibungen.
Inzwischen haben wir schon mehrere Einkäufe bei Temu gemacht. Immer mit der gleich guten Erfahrung einer zeitgerechten Lieferung aller bestellten Artikel in einer Sendung. Bisher war alles frei von Mängeln und es musste nichts zurück geschickt werden. Ich habe daher die Zahlungen stets gleich nach Lieferung freigegeben.

title: A welcome surprise amidst rising costs!
content: Like many of you, I was sceptical about buying anything from them after reading so many reviews that painted a negative picture. I installed the app a year ago and during that time I’ve probably purchased over 1000 items, and in all that time only needed to request a refund on 1 damaged item. The app itself is intuitively designed to gamify receipt of discounts, but even the least astute user will quickly recognise the model of gamification used is “everyone’s a winner” - I doubt it would have been as successful 20-30 years ago, but it does hook you, and again to reiterate - I’ve had some amazing deals, spent far too much money, and if you are a fellow ADHDer I hope you have more discipline and self-control than I do! Giving it 5 stars for all round cost-saving, blatant targeting of neurodivergent shoppers, but selling items that have brought moments of hilarity, enabled me to buy bespoke gifts for staff in the office, and I now own a collection of Pixel light sabres for a fraction of the cost. So many sellers are local stockists in the UK, so I’ve even had items arrive within 2 working days - and for those larger items being sent by land, keep an eye on the tracking updates as there’s nothing quite like realising the banjo you’ve purchased has had visited more countries than you have!! In seriousness, set limits on what you’re spending, take advantage of the cash back offers - they really do work as promised, you just need to complete daily logins to complete the rewards in full. Final thought - if you want pristine packaging and levels of presentation that reflect what you might expect from high street store purchases in the UK, then this retailer and app probably isn’t for you!

title: How to get free stuff!! I’m obsessed!!
content: I love this site. For the first half year I couldn’t figure out why I wasn’t getting free gifts. I learned so much from my own research. One huge key is to go into “you” next to “cart” at bottom right. Then go to messages. Finally promotions. Free gifts are good, credit back great. I almost always do the calendar. I always get something great that I picked on the 20th day. Don’t miss any days though. You must go into it every day, or you have to reclaim days missed, which means that you HAVE to make a purchase. I also get to pick at least 5 gifts I want throughout. Good idea to pre-claim gifts as not to spend as much. It took a long time for playing farmland. I’m talking several months. So slow and time consuming. The one where you need 300 points or something like that takes awhile of purchasing. Do it anyway. It eventually pays off. I also always join Temu circle. $3.33 a month, 3 free gifts a month (although at least a $20 purchase), plus I often get credit back and special deals. I bought an electric lawnmower and got $20 back through Temu circle. If you join, go into Temu circle to get your credit back. It adds up. Remember, you choose if you want notifications. It can be a lot. I hope this helps. Don’t get overwhelmed. Take a break if you need. I hope this helps. ENJOY!! One point, if it tells you something, for instance with credit back, it will tell you to come back daily for maybe 5 days with a certain key word in search. Take a screenshot so you remember what they told you to do, such as type “claimcredit” in search. Usually no spaces. Definitely check for great reviews for purchases. I rarely are disappointed with this.

title: Sells anything and everything.
content: Site is easy to navigate, has a feature to take a picture of a product you are looking for and the app will locate all the sellers on the site selling it. Again I found to copy and paste a product detail in the search also lets you find the best price for a product you have seen listed. Many sellers sell the same product and at varying prices. If you hold product in your basket for a number of days sometimes and offer comes up for just those products. The vouchers are good also and you earn those with purchases. On the whole the site is good, be aware the things shipped by land can take a long time but smaller items and those sold locally are dispatched quickly. Customer service are polite but slow and limited on what they can actually assist you with to sort a problem, they basically record detail and generate a “ticket” for their superiors to deal will and this again takes time. It can be very frustrating at time the slow process and if anything I thing this should be improved. This is a very honest review of Temu and if your wondering I would say try it and I think you will be hooked 😄 read produced detail and materials used thoughtfully and will save disappointments.

title: Temu
content:
Overall, I’m rarely disappointed with what I buy from Temu. My only truly bad experience came when I ordered glass teapots as gifts. The first two arrived as boxes of shattered glass. Not necessarily Temu’s fault, the shipper just put them in a box with no foam, styrofoam or other protection. I had to fight to get a refund on the second teapot. I’m waiting for the last four teapots to arrive and I’m praying these arrive safely.  I shouldn’t have to prove myself based on the volume I order and retain.
Areas I would have Temu improve, get rid of computer generated customer service response and put in actual people to help customers. Second if I send you pictures of a broken item, then refund me without challenge and address the problem with the seller. Finally, don’t make games like Farmland so ridiculously ‘cheap’ by doing things like reducing the value of the ‘waterings’ (point earners) as the customer nears the goal. Keep it consistent throughout the game. I started Farmland (regrettably) and am frustrated by what I now need to finish. I probably will never engage in another TEMU game because of it. If you want to incentivize people to buy more through games, don’t frustrate them by changing the scoring schedule.
Overall I give TEMU a 4 - 5 for product and 4.5-5 on customer service.

title: Handy site for discount products
content: TEMU is a decent online shopping site. Comes in handy when shopping for small appliance and electrical needs. Bought several accessory things at good discount prices compared to some online sites and box stores. Items rate from solar lights to electrical tools appliances, porable usb batteries, ie ect... prices were decent, shipping good and timely. Products arrive well packed and in good condition in almost all cases. So far been decent and dependable when it comes for shopping, paying, small service and shipment. Haven't yet returned anything to see if return policies are good. May return one item so we'll see how that goes. As for the app, search engine and select ability of comparative items is good if not excellent for catalog of products. As for shipping costs, there are generally small shipping fees that may add up if not carefully especially if they are advertising for some secondary " off site" purchases with other companies warehouses. Other things may come with free shipping. There s a Temu club you can join for a small monthly fee if you ship that much to handle some shipping for free vs discounts on certain items to balance shipping costs. The site is somewhat archaic and has some agitation and distraction, when they offer "daily spins" for discount item purchases, redirection, and pop up ads for extra items if your not a member, and occasionally freezes and restarts that losses some shopping products causing some frustration. Not enough to turn it off and not come back but distracts and discerns once in a while.

title: Great for deals if you choose carefully
content:
Temu sells a lot of stuff, and a lot of it is heavily discounted. Unfortunately there are a lot of counterfeits or very poor quality items that you might end up buying, but if you take the time to look through the reviews and see what other people have mentioned about it, it helps narrow down the choice for high quality choices.

Also some of Temu’s promotions are very solid in return value, while some of them are downright not worth it at all. Always look into the “free items” or “returned credits” conditions to get a clearer idea of what you’re getting in return. Personally I like the returned as credit promotions, and the free item ones usually aren’t that great unless it’s exactly what you were looking for. With the return in credits, you can use the credits to purchase what you were actually interested in.

Bonus tip: if you find a promotion that is actually worth it, like spend 65-75 dollars and get 50 dollar worth of credits back over 7 days, Temu usually only lets you choose from an infinite scrolling list in the promotions. A small way around that is to make sure you have all the items you were interested/ vetted to make sure they were reputable first loaded into your cart. Temu’s infinite scrolling will give you random choices but the algorithm is catered to items you’ve looked up or normally purchase, so if you happen to see that reputable item that is currently in your main cart, you know it’s a solid buy that you can add to the promotion’s cart.

title: 95% Happy!
content:
I am new to Temu. For the past couple of months I kinda went nuts with the tax refund & got so many nice things for very little cost-and several free items.
To get the best of what Temu has to offer, I highly recommend the following-
It is important to read the store reviews, the product reviews, look at the photos & videos sent in by purchasers, read the description of the product IN FULL! 2D means flat-for those that don't know-I've seen you on tiktok, lol. Check the measurements-because the one pictured is usually the biggest they carry & there's several choices for sizes (for wall hangings, clothes, drapes, figurines-everything!) The prices are amazing, and if you shop right, your purchases will be too! I opened one box today that I was awe struck by-honestly. It was a caligraphy set with green (fake but pretty) big rhinestones, a feather, several inks of different colors, a feathered caligraphy pen and a non feathered one, a wax stamp, with waxes of many colors, an ink holder and pen holder made from brass. It is so beautiful & was under $20... just checked-it was $10!! Be careful and follow my tried and true plan. Only got two items I wasn't happy with-1 was free-normally the free stuff is fine & the other was some hanger for leggings that cost a buck. No biggy. I have gotten so many items and am 95% happy with my purchases. Happy with the delivery time, as well. For those with shopping addictions-do not follow the buy more and get more - they got me a couple times-but I felt me & my kiddo deserved our items. 🙂❤️✌🏼

title: Sneaky
content:
This is great for good deals on aesthetically pleasing cheap stuff. However it does try to trick you a lot to spend more money by trying to over load you with flashy gamified advertising that will entice you to add to your cart with the promise to “win” more money.
I’ve tried some of the promotions several times and it it even has a status bar that confirms you’ve spent “enough “ to “ qualify” for different promotions (like $100 credit if you buy just 3 more things) but when you buy those 3 things it will prompt you again to buy just 3 more things because the first thing that you bought didn’t add up to enough to get the hundred dollar promotion. So why would you tell me that I got it in the first place? I’ve canceled 3 orders over this, just on the principle!
Then, after I received one of my orders (that went apart of the earlier mentioned promotions) I left a 2 star review on a choker necklace because it’s scratchy and not as sparkly as the pictures make it seem. Just being honest. Well when I hit submit, the app suddenly flashed a prompt to change my 2 stars to a 5 star review and it happened so fast I hit “ok” without even realizing what happened. I went back to check and sure enough, my 5 star review was at the top and the comment said “eh. It’s alright”
Dose that sound like a 5 star review? lol
Luckily I could change it and of course they moved my review to where no one will ever see it. It’s just very dishonest practices, and after my last shipment I’ll be deleting Temu.

title: Tolle Angebote, Super App + Service
content:
Das alles kann ich garnicht alles beschreiben, die App ist bahnbrechend!  Das bemerkt man beim Stöbern. Der Aufbau der App ist sehr übersichtlich gestaltet, es werden produkttechnisch sofort weitere Alternativen angeboten. Die Produktbeschreibungen sind ausführlich und zutreffend. Sehr positiv fällt mir auf, dass es zu den Leitlinien der Produktgrösse bei Bekleidung zwei Tabellen gibt, die auch zutreffen! Eine bezieht sich auf die Abmessung der Person und die zweite auf die Abmessung des Produktes. Da weiß man es dann ganz genau, ob man da reinpasst oder nicht. Oft wird der Warenkorb noch mal deutlich reduziert, klar, damit man endlich den Kauf abschließt.  Und das sind deutliche Reduzierungen, oft um dieHälfte und noch mehr. Und nicht unerwähnt lassen möchte ich den Kundenservice.  Wenn ich , und das kommt selten vor, Ware retournieren muss, erhalte ich die Gutschrift schon bevor die Retoure erfolgt ist. Mit der Anmeldung meiner Retoure ist sofort die Gutschrift da, mit der Begründung von Temu, dass Temu gute Erfahrungen mit mir machte. So ein Vertrauen hat mir noch kein deutscher Händler entgegengebracht. Klar ist Temu eine gewaltige Konkurrenz für den  deutschen Markt. So Behauptungen wie: Die Bekleidung  sei viel zu klein, da asiatische Größen, stimmt nicht! Der Bekleidungssektor  wird grössentechnisch angepasst.
Man fühlt sich in der Tat wie ein König.
Würde gerne mal einen der Entwickler sehen. Von mir gibt es ganz klar 5 Sterne für diese tolle App.

All that said I have spent wayyyyy too much money shopping on temu. Even if the shipping is longer sometimes its still my go to for specific items.

title: Not as bad as I expected.
content: I heard a lot of people say that this app is a scam, and while I can certainly see why they’d think that it actually isn’t a bad place to shop. I will deduct it a star though for one reason; they give you the illusion that you’re winning prizes. When you spin a wheel or pull the lever on a virtual slot machine they will ALWAYS rig it to have the best prize to make you think you got lucky, and they do this to pressure you into taking the deal before it expires. Sometimes they even have promotions where they offer you free items if you invite friends to the app or the event, don’t believe this though since they made this nearly impossible to win. author: K8tie L B

title: For the most part a great app, but some misleading promotions.
content: By and large, Temu offers quality products at fantastic prices, shipping is cheap (if not free) and expeditious, and some of their promotions result in some very desirable freebies. However, the majority of their promotions/deals are incredibly misleading. Their FarmVille promotion reeled me in by saying I was only $10 away from a bunch of free items, the first $9 passed by in under an hour, but the final $1 has taken me more than a week to get down to the final 5 cents, and each time the result of my efforts has been at least halved, if not reduced even more. I’m pretty close to what I hope is my last task, but I won’t be surprised if when I finish it only rewards me with 1 cent, leaving me to grind it out four more times, at which point I’m sure it will reward me with only half a cent, leaving me half a cent from my ultimate reward. Then I’m sure the tasks will reward me with maybe 1/10 of a cent the next four rounds, before surprising me with 5/100 of a cent on what I expect to be the final round and starting that infuriating process all over again. That, and the reliance on other people accepting your already embarrassing invitations are huge, huge aggravations and a disappointments that ultimately ruins what is otherwise a near perfect app.

title: I hate to love it.
content: Temu has some really cool stuff and their prices are cheap too. I have to say that it is better than Wish. But, I have two issues. (1) Sometimes, the pictures of the items are misleading. (2) Everytime I go to the app, I have to go through screen after screen before I can even search for what I want to buy. They want you to spin a wheel saying you get 100% cash back but only after you do all kinds of stuff to get it. Like invite a new app user, make a purchase of $X amount or more. Or they have games you can play like Fishland where you feed these fish and once you get to 100% you win selected prizes. Problem is, once you get to the last 3 or 4%, the feeding slows down and you won’t get your items unless you make purchases to get more food, but only certain items from Temu vendors win you food. It’s a marketing scam. It’s stupid and I don’t have the time to go through a bunch of screens before I can browse items. If you try to exit some screens it won’t let you or it pops up a bunch of other ridiculous scams. Like I said, I love to shop at Temu, but I don’t like their schemes.

title: Too easy to buy something you don’t want and too hard to fix it
content: Temu makes it easy to buy but very difficult to correct mistakes. If you’ve just made a purchase, you have a chance to add other items to your order at a deep discount. If you click on an item to get more details, it’s added to your order and your card is charged. You’ll have to request a refund. If you add an item to your cart and remove it, you may have to remove it several times. There’s a Buy Now button that’s very easy to accidentally press. Your card is immediately charged and you’ll have to request a refund. There aren’t enough purchase confirmation steps which I believe is by design. I’ve deleted all my payment information from the app hoping I don’t make any more unintentional purchases. There’s no chance to really cancel anything. Also, your shipment may be incomplete which I think is also by design. You have to provide the package information and since they usually ship an order in multiple shipments, you may have discarded those packages before you realize you didn’t receive something. Yes I’ve found some good prices but I have to be very careful when using the app. I’m constantly checking my cart to delete things I didn’t want and checking my order history to make sure I didn’t pay for something I didn’t want. Every time, I’ve found something I didn’t want and since I don’t have this issue on other apps, I believe it’s them and I believe it’s intentional. If they can sneak in a few unintentional purchases and make the refund process difficult, they can make more money.

content: There are a lot of things being said about Temu right now, but I have done an extensive search amongst my friends for someone who has experienced these issues personally and I have not found anyone. I am delighted with the Temu app and experience and watch this space for updates on my refund and how long it took. So far the response from Temu is excellent, they are quick and friendly and understanding about someone who is willing but not very able when it comes to shopping online.

title: Nothing ventured, nothing gained
content: I started ordering from Temu about six weeks ago. There delivery by UPS and the USPS are fantastic and accurate.  I have spent about $500 on various products as a test before I bought more expensive items. It is vary frustrating trying to get the point across that a purchase with parts missing is worthless. This took over an hour and may be the plan. It did arrive complete and quicker than normal.  Ontrac is the local delivery service.  Imho they are not reliable or trustworthy.  They are hitting under50%. One delivery never showed. They did not provide a photo of delivery and I have cameras on my property, although I live in a good neighborhood.  It took almost two hours between the two companies.  Ontrac backed their driver on a delivery of a one inch cube.  Temu replaced the 24lb package.    The latest incident said delivery was made at 10:36 AM. I was at home and spent almost two hours trying to get the point across that it was not delivered here. At 4 PM I was walking in my neighborhood when a stranger came up and handed my package that was delivered to his house. Neither TEMU nor ONTRAC will acknowledge this error , nor apologize for it. Both sent notice that delivery was made to my home.  Due to this lack of communication, I will no longer be ordering. I have one order in progress and am hoping for the best.

title: The app is great but the shipping
content:
Temu is pretty great. I have found some pretty great items on Temu. I have to say that I have been  enjoying Temu and have spent a lot of time browsing the App and have bought quite a lot on it from kitchen gadgets to clothing. I have bought puzzles to purses. While I expect my items to take awhile for shipping do to the fact that it is coming from mainland China the lack of information for shipping and tracking does get frustrating. Also about half of my packages DO NOT arrive on time. The company offers $5.00 credit when your package does not arrive by the date that it is due to arrive which is nice but is not really nothing when your packages are constantly late. It was due to arrive December 9th but did not arrive until December 20th. I was beginning to panic a little then.
Either way as I am waiting for my next round of packages to arrive from Temu I did my reviews on all 75 items that I have recently purchased. I am very happy to continue browsing the site for more purchases. Some worth them money and are very nice items and some maybe not so much. Either way it is worth the effort and is fine site.

title: Erstbestellung hat mich überzeugt
content:
Insgesamt habe ich vier Produkte bestellt. Eine Fleecemütze (leider etwas klein-gab es nur in Einheitsgröße), 5 T-Shirts als Unterhemden, 2 Sport T-Shirts und eine Hundedecke zur Abdeckung unseres Betts.

Von der Qualität war ich positiv überrascht. Die T-Shirts passen perfekt und lassen sich angenehm tragen. Den 80% Rabatt für die erste Bestellung hat sich für mich voll gelohnt. Wenn sich das bei weiteren Bestellungen bestätigt, werde ich dort regelmäßig bestellen. Die Lieferzeit mit 10 Tagen war für mich auch akzeptabel, da ich von vornherein wusste, dass die Lieferung aus China kommt. Auch war ich über den Sendungsverlauf immer informiert und konnte hier sehen, dass die Lieferung nicht per Schiff, sondern per Luftfracht nach Europa kam und von der Niederlande zu mir nach Hause geliefert kam.

Nach dieser ersten Erfahrung ist TEMU eine Empfehlung. Allerdings hatte ich aufgrund von Erfahrungen mit anderen Internetanbieter aus China durchaus etwas „Bauchgrummeln“.

title: Shopping is great, but Temu policies and offers are deceptive
content:
I have been ordering from Temu for quite some time, and for the most part I love it. The prices are good, and I’ve rarely had a problem with an order. Those times I have experienced a problem Temu has quickly made it right. However, even their customer support agents don’t understand Temu’s arbitrary policies. For instance, Temu has a price adjustment policy that you are told in plain language that, if the same item you purchased is lowered by the seller within 30 days, you will receive a refund for the difference. But then when it arbitrarily isn’t applied the customer support agent has to send you a different policy that would take a team of mathematicians to figure out! Also beware that you will be endlessly badgered to promote Temu to your friends. Don’t even attempt one of the “free items” ploys. Unless you have thousands of friends that are not already using Temu, or you put $60 orders in every week, you will be feeding fish or growing crops for months, and I do mean months! (Fishland game and Farmland game) Save yourself the trouble and just buy the items; otherwise, you will find yourself stuck in a game that you hate but don’t want to stop playing, because by the time you realize it is practically impossible to win you already have too much time invested to just throw it all away.
So, if you are looking for some good prices, you will find them on Temu. Just don’t fall into the trap of being a marketing agent, and don’t rely too heavily on promises and procedures.

(Fishland game and Farmland game) Save yourself the trouble and just buy the items; otherwise, you will find yourself stuck in a game that you hate but don’t want to stop playing, because by the time you realize it is practically impossible to win you already have too much time invested to just throw it all away.
So, if you are looking for some good prices, you will find them on Temu. Just don’t fall into the trap of being a marketing agent, and don’t rely too heavily on promises and procedures.

title: Great service.
content: The delivery and returns is very good, the clothing I have bought is really good quality and sizing is just about spot on for me. Somethings are great but also somethings are a load of rubbish. It's also so cheap I've not bothered sending stuff back got a draw full of stuff that I should have really sent back instead it will end up in the bin. One other thing they bombard you with offer's,  emails, WhatsApp, text messages send you offers which when you try to use them you have to send more and more and end up with 2p off your order. If you leave something in your basket you get messages to death telling you your basket is calling. Do not be drawn in as when you look at the basket you end up filling it again and again. I have spent over £1000 quid in three months I have now blocked everything except emails as it's turned into an addiction. Be warned but the clothes are really well made and look good on.

title: Tolle Seite zum bestellen der verrücktesten Sachen
content:
Ich bin auf die Temu- App durch meine Tochter gekommen. Ich sollte natürlich für Sie am Glücksrad drehen, damit sie Gratisgeschenke bekommt. Dadurch wurde auch ich geködert😏 und habe mir auch 5 Geschenke ausgesucht. Da das System ja so aufgebaut ist, immer und immer wieder neue Leute an Temu zu bringen, damit sie die App installieren, wurde es sehr schwierig. Meistens bei den letzten 0,80€ bin ich gescheitert🤷‍♀️man hatte mindestens 8- 10 Leute die mitgemacht haben und es klappte damit immer noch nicht. Sehr ärgerlich. Vielleicht sollte man selber entscheiden können, wieviele Gratisgeschenke man möchte, eine Wahl zwischen 1 und 5 Geschenken.
Nichts desto Trotz bleibe ich bei Temu, weil es wirklich total tolle und preiswerte Dinge gibt.

content: I always recommend temu to my friends. I did the 10 free gifts and I received them and I told all my friends. Usually I’m so understanding with problems like this but that was just so unfair especially seeing the timer keep ticking down and both of them expiring.

title: DON’T MISS OUT
content:
First of all, if you haven't used app yet make sure to enter the reward coupon «3️⃣3️⃣0️⃣3️⃣4️⃣9️⃣3️⃣7️⃣0️⃣» on the sign up screen to get a $100 bonus! I have spent about $150 so far on Temu. I have loved everything so far except for one thing and I have probably bought 30 items. I was pleasantly surprised with the quality of most things. Some were better than others but for the price I sure can't complain. I will be back for sure. You can't lose even if one thing turns out not so great because it is so inexpensive. The shipping is fast for what is probably coming from over seas. maybe a week or little more.

They will text you a lot of times with updates on your order so you are never left in the dark wondering where your package is. I love getting a deal so Temu is my kind of place to shop. I recommend looking around on the site for the best deal because many times they will have it cheaper from a different seller suppose because there are multiples of similar items. They also send you coupons sometimes. If you have friend who you can sign up you can get a lot of free stuff but I didn't want to bother anyone. I like to wait til they send me a coupon to place an order. Try it you will like it. Warning most the time when they offer free gifts you are going to have to get friends to sign up and you will play games to get the points then you will need more points to win and you will need more points to win and you will need friends to sign up to actually win the prizes you have!!

A partir de esa experiencia ME ENCANTA PEDIR EN TEMU y ahora solo tengo paciencia para la entrega en casa
